title: Snoop Dogg Is Dropping His First NFT Single On Friday Only 20K Copies
htmlContent:
Snoop Dogg, throughout his legendary, has sold 12.5 million albums in the United and 37 million albums worldwide. He is one of the most recognizable artists globally and has created 14 top ten singles on the Billboard Hot 100.

On Friday morning, The Doggfather announced on Clubhouse that he would be releasing his first-ever 'Non-fungible token. Better known as 'NFT' at 4 PM PST.

It will be available to the first 20k people worldwide. Snoop played a sample of the NFT on the Clubhouse stage entitled "It's a Doggy World."

The track is fire and Snoop has another hit on his hand, but unfortunately there will only 20k copies.
